prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select a ready-to-adopt pet or build a custom desktop companion."]
1: ["Sign In to Reconnect", "Use your primary account to automatically sync and restore your existing desktop pets.", "Make sure to use the email address associated with your original adoption."]
2: ["Sign in now to save your selected path."]
3: ["Verify Photo Quality", "Ensure face is clearly visible with balanced lighting before generating."]
4: ["Listen to your pet's voice before finalizing.", "Hear Your Pet's Voice", "Tap below to play audio clips of your companion.", "Play Sample Voice"]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Deployment", "Enable desktop notification to get alerted the instant your pet appears."]
6: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to access voice chat, hide options, and settings."]
7: ["Use well-lit, front-facing photos for optimal 3D desktop pet generation."]
8: ["Unlocked: Special Starter Accessory!"]
9: ["Quick Start (Skip Story)"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photos of user)
